# Contract: design-system-build

SumitCraft addition. Category: design. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Turn design decisions into tokens and components, with contrast, reference, scale, duplicate, state, motion and hard-coded-value checks.

## Use it for
- "set up design tokens"
- "check my colour contrast"

## Not for
- extract another company's brand (brand-kit)

## Accepted inputs
tokens.json and component pages.

## Deliverables
tokens.css with reduced-motion block, token report, CSS audit.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+

Optional:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Collect the decisions
2. Write tokens.json
3. Compile and check:
4. Build the components
5. Audit the stylesheet
6. Look at it

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Unmade taste decisions offered as options

## Quality checks
- 32 checks pass on the example; 11 fail on the broken copy
- CSS audit clean

## Common failures
- Contrast fudged per component instead of at the token

## Limitations
- Contrast uses WCAG 2.x, not APCA

## Reproducible example
examples/garden-ui.
